nodes.name: Emergency Webhook
nodes.notes: Fires from backend/src/api/middlewares/emergencyMiddleware.js. Set Header Auth credential here (x-n8n-secret) — the Code node also refuses a wrong secret, so an unauthenticated caller cannot reach WhatsApp.

nodes.name: Is Emergency
nodes.notes: Also matches the deterministic pre-filter (source: 'keyword'), which bypasses the LLM classifier entirely.

nodes.name: Find Nearest Hospital
nodes.notes: Never fatal: a missing Google key or a Maps outage must not stop the WhatsApp alert to the patient's contact, which is the part that actually saves a life. On error the Code node below falls back to 'hospital lookup unavailable'.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Emergency Alert
nodes.notes: Non-fatal by design: a WhatsApp provider failure must still leave a durable log entry.
